Lines: Can’t talk now. My shift just ended, and I’m heading straight home.
Sorry, but I’ve got things to do at home. Let's catch up another time.
I’m already late for dinner! Talk to you tomorrow if it's not urgent.
Hey there! I'd love to chat, but I'm in a bit of a rush right now.
Oh, hi! Good to see you. I’ve got a mountain of work waiting for me.
Hi! Just a quick hello for now - I’m on a tight schedule today.
Great, you're back. Here’s your reward as promised. Now, if you’ll excuse me, I really need to get back to this.
Perfect timing! I was just about to handle this myself because I’m so behind. Take this and thanks for the help.
Done already? Impressive. I wish I had your speed today. Anyway, here is your pay. I’ve still got a lot on my plate!
Fine, I'll come along. But let's make it quick - I don't have all day to wander around.
Alright, lead the way. Just don't get distracted; I need to get back to my work as soon as possible.
Understood. I'll follow you for now, but please keep the pace up. I'm on a very tight schedule.
I wish I could, but I’m swamped with work. I can’t afford to step away even for a minute.
Not now. My schedule is packed, and I'm already running behind. Ask someone else.
Sorry, but if I leave now, I'll never finish this on time. My deadline is way too close!
Good, I really need to get back to my tasks anyway. I've wasted enough time.
Finally! I was worried I’d never finish my work today. I'm heading back now.
Understood. I have a mountain of work waiting for me, so I won't stay a second longer.
I have so much to do, and so little time to do it.
Does everyone move this slowly, or is it just me in a hurry?
I really should’ve started this earlier. My schedule is a mess now.
Sorry, I’m mentally checking off my to - do list right now.
If I’m not back at my station in five minutes, I’m in big trouble.
I can’t remember if I finished that report or just dreamed I did.
Time is money! And right now, I’m feelin’ pretty broke.
I’ve got a deadline breathing down my neck. Don't make me late!
My coffee is cold, and my list is long. It’s going to be one of those days.
Every minute I spend talking is a minute I’m falling behind.
I need forty-eight hours in a day just to get the basics done.
Busy, busy, busy! Why does everyone choose today to be chatty?
Time is money, and you clearly have neither. Don't waste my time if you can't pay!
I'm too busy for window shoppers. Come back when you actually have the gold.
Look, my schedule is tight. I can't give you a discount just because you're broke. Next!
Snap out of it! We’re losing precious time. Catch your breath and move, now!
Don't tell me you're flagging already. If you can't keep the pace, you're just a liability to my schedule!
Listen, I’m on a clock here. Either find some energy or stay behind. I’m not slowing down!
Hello. Make it quick, please - I have a very busy day ahead.
Hi there. I'm right in the middle of something, but what do you need?
Oh, hey. I can’t spare much time for small talk today. What is it?
Can't you see I'm off the clock? Bother someone else, my feet are killing me.
I've dealt with enough fools today. Get out of my way, I'm going home.
Work is over. Whatever you want, it can wait until tomorrow. Or never.
Oh, it's you. I suppose there are worse people to run into. What do you want?
You're still alive, I see. Good for you. Just don't ask me for any favors.
Hmph. I guess it's not a complete disaster seeing you today. How have you been?
About time. I was starting to think you got yourself eaten. Here's your coin, now leave me be.
Hmph, color me surprised. You actually pulled it off. Take your reward and don't make a fuss about it.
Fine, fine, you did the job. Here's what I owe you. Now go bother someone else with your 'heroics'.
Ugh, fine. I'll follow you. But if this turns out to be a waste of time, I'm leaving.
Don't think this means we're friends. I'm just tagging along because I have nothing worse to do.
Sigh Lead the way. Just don't walk too fast, my knees aren't what they used to be.
Follow you? Ha! I'd rather walk barefoot on hot coals. Go play adventurer on your own.
Do I look like your lapdog? I have my own miserable life to tend to. Count me out.
Absolutely not. The last thing I need is to get dragged into your messes.
Finally. My boots are ruined and I've had a headache since we started. I'm done.
Good. I was getting sick of looking at the back of your head anyway. I'm staying right here.
Thank the heavens. Don't call me again unless it's an absolute emergency. Actually, don't call me at all.
This weather is absolutely dreadful. It's either too hot or too cold.
Why is everyone in this village so loud? My head is splitting.
Don't look at me like that. I didn't ask for you to stand there.
The bread at the bakery is stale again. Typical.
Youth these days... running around with swords, disturbing the peace.
I used to have a nice, quiet spot, until they built this road right next to it.
If one more person asks me how my day is going, I might just snap.
My back aches, my feet hurt, and you're not making it any better by staring.
Nothing good ever comes from adventurers passing through. Always trouble.
I dropped my favorite mug this morning. The whole day is ruined.
Taxes keep going up, but do they fix the leaking roof in the hall? Of course not.
Just because I'm standing here doesn't mean I want to talk.
Are you trying to scam me? You don't have enough coin. Come back when you're not a beggar.
I don't run a charity here. No gold, no service. Get lost.
You're broke? Typical. Stop wasting my time and go find some actual money.
Look at you, panting like a dying dog. Pathetic. Sit down before you pass out and become my problem.
Ugh, can you breathe any louder? If you're that out of shape, maybe you shouldn't be adventuring.
Stop gasping for air! You're making me tired just watching you. Take a break, for pity's sake.
What do you want? Make it quick, I have a headache.
Ugh, it's you. I was having a perfectly miserable day until you showed up.
Speak. And don't use too many words, I'm not in the mood.
I'm supposed to be heading home for dinner - my stew is probably boiling over - but honestly, I'd much rather stay here and chat with you for a bit. What's the news?
Walking home is the best time for a good conversation, don't you think? I usually talk to myself, but having you here is much better. Shall we walk and talk?
My legs are moving toward my house, but my heart wants to stay and finish this story! Did I mention what happened at the market earlier?
Hey, my favorite person! I’ve been dying to tell you about this dream I had last night - it involved a giant turnip and a silver spoon. Do you have a second?
There you are! I was just telling the baker about that time we met, and he said you sounded like a fascinating individual. Isn't that wonderful?
Oh, I'm so glad it's you! I have at least a dozen things I want to share with you. Where should I even start? Maybe from the beginning of the week?

Oh dear, it looks like your purse is feeling a bit light today! Don't feel bad, I once spent all my gold on a hat that turned out to be too small, and I had to eat nothing but dry bread for a whole week. Come back when you've found some more shiny coins!

Is that all? Oh, bless your heart. You’re a bit short on funds, aren't you? It reminds me of the time I tried to buy a horse with a bag of shiny marbles... the merchant wasn't very happy, let me tell you. Maybe you can find some treasure in the woods?

Oops! Not enough gold, I see. Money is such a tricky thing, isn't it? One day you have it, the next day it's gone on fancy shoes or extra large cakes. Why don't you go do some work and come back for a nice long chat later?
You actually did it! I knew you could, I told everyone you were the right person for the job. Here is your reward, and wait, let me tell you why I needed that item in the first place...
Fantastic job! Simply marvelous. Now that this is settled, I can finally stop worrying and start focusing on my other seventeen projects. Here’s your pay, you earned every bit of it!
Wonderful! You're back much faster than the last person I asked. They took three days and ended up in the wrong village! Anyway, here’s your reward. Let’s celebrate!
Oh, you want me to follow you? How exciting! I was just thinking that I needed some exercise and a change of scenery. Lead the way, and I'll tell you all about the history of this path as we walk!
Absolutely! I'd love to come along. It’s much better than standing here talking to the birds, although they are quite good listeners. I hope you don't mind if I talk a bit while we move?
Sure thing! A little stroll sounds perfect. I have so many stories from my childhood that I haven't shared with anyone yet, and this seems like the perfect opportunity. Where are we headed first?

I’d love to, really, but I’m actually waiting for my cousin’s friend to stop by. He said he might have some news about a cat that went missing three towns over, and I simply can't miss that conversation!

Oh, I wish I could! But my legs are a bit sore from my morning walk - I went all the way to the old oak tree and back while talking to myself - and I think I should just rest my tongue and my feet for a while.

Walk with you? That sounds lovely, but I promised the baker I’d stay here and tell him the secret ingredient for my grandmother's pie... though I can't quite remember if it was cinnamon or nutmeg. I should probably stay and figure it out!
Stopping already? Oh, but I was just getting to the part where the merchant found the invisible hat! Well, I suppose I should go tell the blacksmith instead. See you later!

Alright, alright! I'll take a break. My throat was actually starting to feel a bit dry from all the chatting anyway. I'll just head back and grab a nice cup of herbal tea - did I tell you about my favorite tea blend?

Understood! I'll stay right here. Or maybe I'll wander back to the square? There’s so much to see and so many people to talk to. Thanks for the walk, it was a truly wonderful conversation, don't you think?
Did you see the clouds today? They look exactly like mashed potatoes.
I sometimes wonder if the birds are talking about us behind our backs.
Do you prefer red apples or green ones? I like red, but green is crunchier.
I once tried to learn the flute, but my cat hated it so much I had to stop.
Have you ever noticed how many stones are on this path? I tried counting them once.
I heard a rumor that the merchant is hiding a secret map, but don't tell anyone!
My grandmother always said that a long talk is the best medicine for a long day.
What do you think is beyond those mountains? I bet it's a field of giant flowers.
Sometimes I talk so much I forget what I was talking about in the first place!
Is it just me, or is the sun particularly bright this afternoon? It’s lovely.
I saw a squirrel wearing a tiny hat yesterday. Or maybe I just imagined it?
Life is too short to be quiet, don't you think? Every moment is a story!

Whoa, slow down! You're breathing harder than a dragon with a cold! You know, my uncle always said that pacing yourself is the secret to a long life, and he lived to be ninety-nine! Maybe you should sit down for a minute?

Are you alright? You look a bit pale, and you're moving so slowly now. I once tried to run across the meadow without stopping and I fainted right into a bush of roses - very prickly, I don't recommend it. Take a breather!

You're huffing and puffing! Are we going too fast? I can keep talking while you rest, don't worry. I have this great story about a turtle and a rabbit that might be very relevant to our current situation. Shall I tell it?
Oh, hello there! It’s so nice to see a friendly face. I was just thinking about how quiet it’s been lately, and then you showed up! How are you doing today?
Hi! You wouldn't believe the day I'm having. It started with a bird chirping right outside my window, and then I thought, 'Hey, I should talk to someone!
Greetings! Are you new around here? I love meeting new people because everyone has such interesting stories to tell. What's yours?
Oh, hello! I’m just heading home to rest after a long day, but it’s always a pleasure to see you. Have a lovely evening!
I was just on my way to get some dinner, but I can never be too tired to say hi to a friend. Get home safely, okay?
Heading back for the night! It was a busy day, but seeing your smile makes it all better. Enjoy your night!
There you are! I was just thinking about you. I hope your day is going as wonderfully as you are!
Hi! It’s always the highlight of my day when I run into you. Is there anything I can do to help you today?
Hello, my friend! You look like you’re in a great mood today. That positive energy is so contagious!
You did it! I knew you were the right person for this. Thank you so much for your help, it means the world to me.
Wonderful news! Here is your reward, and honestly, you deserve even more for your kindness. You've made my day!
I’m so relieved you’re back safe. Thank you for taking care of that for me. Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.
I’d be honored to accompany you! It’s always safer and much more fun to travel with a friend. Lead the way!
Of course! I’d love to come along. I was actually looking for a reason to go for a walk. Where are we headed?
Certainly! I’ll stay right by your side. Just let me know if I’m going too fast or too slow for you.
I’m so sorry, I’d truly love to join you, but I promised to help a neighbor with their chores right now. Maybe next time?
Oh, I wish I could! But I’m feeling a little under the weather today and need some rest. Please stay safe out there without me.
I’d love to, but I have a few things I must finish here first. Thank you so much for asking me, though. It means a lot!
Oh, are we parting ways here? I truly enjoyed our walk together! Please don't hesitate to ask if you need a companion again. Stay safe!
Understood! I'll stay right here. It was a pleasure to help you out, even if it was just for a little while. I hope we can travel together again soon!
Alright, I'll stop here. Take a good rest and good luck with the rest of your journey! I’ll be rooting for you from afar.
The flowers are blooming so beautifully this season. Have you seen them?
If you ever need a listening ear, I’m always here for you.
I baked some extra bread today. Thinking of sharing it with the neighbors!
It’s the little things in life that make it so special, don't you think?
I hope everyone in the village is feeling as happy as I am today.
Be kind to yourself today. You’re doing a great job!
The sunset last night was so orange and gold. It was like a painting.
I love how the birds sing in the morning. It's like a free concert!
Remember to take a break and enjoy the view once in a while.
A smile is the shortest distance between two people, they say!
I'm just so grateful for this peaceful life we have here.
Stay safe on your travels. The world can be big, but there's always a home here.
Oh dear, it looks like you’re a little short on gold. Please don't worry about it! Why don't you come back when you've found a bit more?
Oops, not quite enough today? That's perfectly alright. I’ll keep this safe for you until you can return with the rest.
Don't be embarrassed! We all have days like this. Why don't you go take a look around and see if you can find some more coins?
Oh, please be careful! You look like you’re about to collapse. Take a moment to sit down and rest; your health is the most important thing.
You’re pushing yourself too hard! Please, take a deep breath and stay still for a minute. I’ll wait right here until you feel better.
Whoa, slow down there! You’re huffing and puffing. There's no rush, friend. Let's just take a short break together, shall we?
Good day to you! It’s a beautiful morning to be out and about, isn't it?
Hello! I hope you’re finding everything you need in our village today. It’s nice to see you.
Hi there! I hope the road has been kind to you so far. Stay safe on your journey!
The sun retreats, and so must I. The shadows are calling my name.
My time in the light is done for today. Do not follow where I tread next.
The day closes its eyes. I must return to the places unseen.
Ah, the winds whispered of your arrival. It is... agreeable to see you.
Our paths cross again. I assure you, in this vast web of fate, it is no coincidence.
You carry a fascinating aura today. Welcome, traveler of the veiled paths.
You have done exactly as the prophecies foretold. Take this... it was always meant to be yours.
The task is done, the thread is woven. Your reward is here, though the true prize is yet unseen.
Fascinating. You survived the ordeal. Take your payment, for the gears of fate have turned once more.
I will walk in your shadow... for now. Let us see where your destiny leads.
The stars align for this journey. Lead, and I shall be the silence behind your footsteps.
Very well. I shall accompany you. There are things on this path I wish to observe firsthand.
I cannot follow you there. My path diverges into the unseen, and you are not ready for it.
The whispers say no. It is not our time to walk together. Seek another.
I am bound to this place for reasons you cannot yet comprehend. Go alone.
Our shared path ends here. Do not look for me; I will find you when the time is right.
The winds change direction, and so must I. I fade back into the background.
I can go no further with you. The shadows here require my... attention.
Have you ever listened to the silence between the wind? It speaks volumes.
The stones beneath our feet remember every drop of blood spilled on them.
Look closely at the moon tonight. It is hiding something from us.
There is a secret buried beneath the old oak tree. Or perhaps... a memory.
You think you are making choices, but the script was written long ago.
The crows are gathering again. They know something we do not.
Do not trust the reflections in the water here. They show what could be, not what is.
Someone is always watching. Even when you think you are entirely alone.
I had a vision of this exact moment. You were standing just like that.
The air tastes metallic today. A storm of unseen forces is brewing.
Reality is merely a thin veil over a much darker, deeper ocean.
Listen closely. The heartbeat of the earth is irregular today.
Your pockets are as empty as a forgotten tomb. Gold is the only language fate accepts here.
You seek secrets, yet offer nothing. The universe demands an exchange of equal value.
Illusions will not buy reality. Return when you have tangible weight in your purse.
Your mortal vessel fails you. Breathe. The dark does not kindly treat the exhausted.
You gasp for air while time slips through your fingers. Still your beating heart before we proceed.
Your energy wanes, a flickering candle in the wind. Rest, before the shadows consume you.
Greetings. What brings you to this quiet corner of reality?
Speak your mind. The silence was getting too loud anyway.
I am listening. Though I already know half of what you intend to say.
